paragraphs: Spain is celebrating a huge victory after defeating Argentina in the World Cup final, with over a million fans gathering in Madrid for a parade.

A goal scored in extra time secured Spain’s triumph and ended Argentina’s hopes of winning consecutive titles. According to experts, Spain truly deserved to win because they functioned as a complete, well-organized team rather than relying on individual talent. Throughout the tournament, Spain kept several clean sheets and maintained control during the final match. Spain’s success stands out as a well-deserved reward for their long-term investment in youth development and a strong football identity.

The event also sparked debate due to its American influence, including a long halftime show and the presence of political leaders like Donald Trump. The event was the most profitable World Cup in history, and top tickets reached unprecedented prices. Experts believe the tournament has changed global football forever.
